title: Camp Sabra

services.name: Rentals & Retreats
services.desc: Introduce your family to camp through sailing, skiing, tubing, zip-lining, climbing, campfires and more - Sabra-style! Our all-inclusive weekends include lodging, food and all the Camp Sabra activities you can handle. You must log in to your Camp-In Touch account to register. If you do not already have a Camp-In Touch account, please use this link. Once your account is created, you will be able to register for Family Weekends from your home page.
